info.title: CPA API Documentation
info.description: Documentation for CPA APIs available for use by the public.

get.description:
Returns a signed URL that can be used to download the requested file. A successful response returns a 307 redirect, which will automatically begin the file download if your application follows redirects.

Example usage:
```bash
curl -X GET "https://api.comptroller.texas.gov/sift/v1/sift/public/get-link?file-path=sift%2Fgisss%2FAbilene_MSA-2021Q2.zip" \
  -H "x-api-key: API_KEY"
```

parameters.name: file-path
parameters.description: URL-encoded path of file to retrieve.

parameters.name: x-api-key
parameters.description: API key for authentication. To obtain an API key, [register here](https://data-secure.comptroller.texas.gov/main/my-profile?section=developer).

Location.description: Signed URL used to download file

example.message: Requested file currently unavailable via API.

401.description: Forbidden - API key not provided or invalid

example.message: You do not have access to this API.

429.description: Too Many Requests - Rate or monthly limits exceeded

example.message: Request submissions exceeded rate or monthly limits.
The file-path query parameter is required.

get.description:
Return list of files available for download. The filter-by-quarter query parameter is optional. If excluded, will return all available files.

Example usage:
```bash
curl -X GET "https://api.comptroller.texas.gov/sift/v1/sift/public/list-files?filter-by-quarter=2021Q2" \
  -H "x-api-key: API_KEY"
```

parameters.name: filter-by-quarter
parameters.description: Filter for files from a specific quarter, like 2021Q2.

parameters.name: x-api-key
parameters.description: API key for authentication. To obtain an API key, [register here](https://data-secure.comptroller.texas.gov/main/my-profile?section=developer).

200.description: List of files available for download

401.description: Forbidden - API key not provided or invalid

example.message: You do not have access to this API.

429.description: Too Many Requests - Rate or monthly limits exceeded

example.message: Request submissions exceeded rate or monthly limits.

get.summary: Get single row from Open Data table
get.description:
Retrieve a single row from an Open Data table by table name and article id.
Requires both table_id and id as path parameters.

Example usage:
```bash
curl -X GET "https://api.comptroller.texas.gov/open-data/v1/tables/exemption/A12345"
```

parameters.name: table_id
parameters.description: Table name.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Article id.

get.summary: Get sales tax payer by taxpayer ID
get.description:
Returns a single sales tax payer (STP) by taxpayer ID.

Example usage:
```bash
curl -X GET "https://api.comptroller.texas.gov/public-data/v1/public/sales-tax-payer/12345678901" \
-H "x-api-key: API_KEY"
```

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The 11 digit taxpayer ID. Must be 11 digits.

parameters.name: x-api-key
parameters.description: API key for authentication. To obtain an API key, [register here](https://data-secure.comptroller.texas.gov/main/my-profile?section=developer).

example.error: Error - Taxpayer ID must be 11 digits long.

404.description: No sales tax payer found for the given taxpayer ID

get.summary: Search sales tax payer locations by taxpayer ID
get.description:
Returns a list of locations for a given sales tax payer (STP) by taxpayer ID with optional filtering.

Example usage:
```bash
curl -X GET "https://api.comptroller.texas.gov/public-data/v1/public/sales-tax-payer/12345678901/locations?page=1&pageSize=10&globalFilter=test" \
-H "x-api-key: API_KEY"
```

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The 11 digit taxpayer ID. Must be 11 digits.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number for pagination. Must be a positive integer. Defaults to 1.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Number of results per page. Must be a positive integer. Defaults to 10.

parameters.name: globalFilter
parameters.description: Optional filter string. 1-50 characters.

parameters.name: x-api-key
parameters.description: API key for authentication. To obtain an API key, [register here](https://data-secure.comptroller.texas.gov/main/my-profile?section=developer).

200.description: List of locations associated with the given taxpayer ID

400.description: Invalid request (invalid id or query parameters)

example.error: Error - Taxpayer ID must be 11 digits long.

404.description: No locations found for the given taxpayer ID

get.description:
Retrieve franchise account and officer details by taxpayer ID.

Example usage:
```bash
curl -X GET "https://api.comptroller.texas.gov/public-data/v1/public/franchise-tax/12345678901" \
-H "x-api-key: API_KEY"
```

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Taxpayer's unique 11-digit ID

parameters.name: x-api-key
parameters.description: API key for authentication. To obtain an API key, [register here](https://data-secure.comptroller.texas.gov/main/my-profile?section=developer).

get.description:
Search for FTAS records by taxpayer-id, name, or file-number.

Example usage:
```bash
curl -X GET "https://api.comptroller.texas.gov/public-data/v1/public/franchise-tax-list?taxpayerId=123456789" \
-H "x-api-key: API_KEY"
```

parameters.name: taxpayerId
parameters.description: Taxpayer Number (9 or 11 digits)

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Entity Name (2-50 chars, no < >)

parameters.name: fileNumber
parameters.description: File Number (6-10 digits, left-padded to 10)

parameters.name: x-api-key
parameters.description: API key for authentication. To obtain an API key, [register here](https://data-secure.comptroller.texas.gov/main/my-profile?section=developer).

get.description:
Returns a list of sales tax payer locations matching the search criteria.

Example usage:
```bash
curl -X GET "https://api.comptroller.texas.gov/public-data/v1/public/sales-tax-payer-location?ZIPCODE=78701" \
-H "x-api-key: API_KEY"
```

parameters.name: ZIPCODE
parameters.description: The 5-digit zip code. Required if LOCATION_NAME is not provided.

parameters.name: LOCATION_NAME
parameters.description: The location name. Required if ZIPCODE is not provided.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (default 1).

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Number of results per page (default 10).

parameters.name: sortBy
parameters.description: Field to sort by. Allowed values: TAXPAYER_ID, LOCATION_NAME, LOCATION_NUMBER, STREET, CITY, STATE, ZIPCODE, PERMIT_START_DT, PERMIT_END_DT, or STATUS. Defaults to LOCATION_NAME.

parameters.name: sortOrder
parameters.description: Sort order, either ASC (ascending) or DESC (descending). Defaults to ASC.

parameters.name: x-api-key
parameters.description: API key for authentication. To obtain an API key, [register here](https://data-secure.comptroller.texas.gov/main/my-profile?section=developer).

200.description: List of sales tax payer locations found

example.error: Invalid location name. Must be at least 2 characters.

get.description:
Returns a list of sales tax payers matching the search criteria.

Example usage:
```bash
curl -X GET "https://api.comptroller.texas.gov/public-data/v1/public/sales-tax-payer?searchType=taxpayerId&TAXPAYER_ID=12345678901" \
-H "x-api-key: API_KEY"
```

parameters.name: searchType
parameters.description: The type of search to perform.

parameters.name: TAXPAYER_ID
parameters.description: The 11-digit taxpayer ID. Required if searchType is 'taxpayerId'.

parameters.name: FEI_NUMBER
parameters.description: The 9-digit FEI number. Required if searchType is 'fein'.

parameters.name: FIRST_NAME
parameters.description: The first name. Required if searchType is 'name'.

parameters.name: MIDDLE_NAME
parameters.description: The middle name. Optional if searchType is 'name'.

parameters.name: LAST_NAME
parameters.description: The last name. Required if searchType is 'name'.

parameters.name: BUSINESS_NAME
parameters.description: The legal name. Required if searchType is 'legalName'.

parameters.name: STATUS
parameters.description: The permit status.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (default 1).

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Number of results per page (default 10).

parameters.name: sortBy
parameters.description: Field to sort by. Allowed values: TAXPAYER_ID, FEI_NUMBER, BUSINESS_NAME, INDIVIDUAL_NAME, LAST_NAME, STREET, CITY, STATE, ZIPCODE, or STATUS. Defaults to TAXPAYER_ID.

parameters.name: sortOrder
parameters.description: Sort order, either ASC (ascending) or DESC (descending). Defaults to ASC.

parameters.name: x-api-key
parameters.description: API key for authentication. To obtain an API key, [register here](https://data-secure.comptroller.texas.gov/main/my-profile?section=developer).

200.description: List of sales tax payers found
